artifacts.scope: full SHA256/size against recorded generation/result identities; payload decoding and numerical replay are not performed

inputs.scope: full byte hashes; no data preparation, import of training code, or device initialization

interpretation: passed means observed terminal release and recorded file integrity only; execution failure, numerical/discrete validity, recovery trajectory and learning remain separate conclusions

device_locks.method: read /proc/locks by device/inode; never acquire a queue/device lock

job_lock.method: read /proc/locks by device/inode; never acquire a queue/device lock

attempts.scope: release of this job's cooperative ownership; another job may now hold the physical device

systemd.expected_cgroup_basis: observed user slice + exact service unit name
